original.name: midnight
original.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready transparent 2D game UI pet sprite sheet, PNG.
Create exactly one SQUARE 1024x1024 image with a REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA background. Exactly FOUR frames in a precise invisible 2x2 grid of equal 512x512 cells. Never paint a checkerboard or any background color. No visible grid, borders, panels, words, numbers, labels, watermark, scenery, floor, cast shadow, or props outside the character.
Subject: an ORIGINAL cute tiny robot mascot, consistent identical design in all four frames: rounded light ice-blue shell, dark navy face screen, glowing cyan small bean-shaped eyes and a simple cyan mouth, a small antenna, short arms and legs. Polished refined 2D game UI character illustration, soft cel shading and controlled blue/cyan rim lighting, readable at small sizes, original character unrelated to existing IP.
EXACT FRAME ORDER: TOP LEFT idle: relaxed standing, gentle smile with mouth CLOSED, arms relaxed. TOP RIGHT talk: mouth visibly OPEN while speaking, one small hand making an explanatory gesture. BOTTOM LEFT point: one hand/arm raised and pointing to the UPPER LEFT as if teaching. BOTTOM RIGHT happy: BOTH small hands raised in happiness, cheerful expression.
COMPOSITION IS CRITICAL: Every frame shows the whole robot including antenna, hands and both feet, no cropping. Same character body scale, same camera angle, same feet baseline and horizontal center relative to each cell. Center x=256 within each 512px cell. Feet baseline y=430 within each cell (global y=430 for upper row, y=942 for lower row). Entire silhouette including hands and antenna must fit INSIDE a 350px wide by 350px high safe box in its own cell, never exceed 70% of cell width or height. Keep generous fully transparent margin around EACH frame; no pixel may cross a cell boundary. Not a collage: the frame layout must be an exact evenly spaced 2-by-2 sprite sheet. Actual transparent alpha PNG, exactly 1024x1024.
